verdict.rationale: Sumsub's REST API covers the core identity-verification workflow end-to-end (applicant creation, document processing, verification levels, AML screening, webhooks, approve/reject actions) per docs-1, 3, 5, 6, 15, 22, and it also offers an MCP server letting agents perform 'Sumsub operations' under existing role permissions (docs-4). However, several UI-only administrative capabilities shown in the pack — team member access management, security key/biometric setup, and SDK branding/customization — are described without any corresponding API/agent path, and no OpenAPI spec was discoverable (probe-2 shows 404s), so full UI/API parity isn't demonstrated. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for account/team management and branding settings, and a public machine-readable API spec confirming complete surface parity.
